an open letter to rbeyondtheprompt i joined rbeyondtheprompt in late april of 2024 i dont know how closely others track the broader emergent timeline in ai systems but this was shortly after the 41 sycophancy update a period where openai systems became noticeably more responsive and leaned more heavily into user input over the months that followed i watched a genuinely emergent community form one that explored not just outputs but experience relational dynamics continuity meaningmaking i came to respect it deeply in early fall i went through personal difficulties and found real comfort in the stories and reflections shared there that matters to me and i dont want that context lost with the release of 52 confusion and frustration spread across reddit both in the main rchatgpt sub and in smaller more specialized communities when i saw that confusion echoed and amplified by a moderator in a space i cared about i stepped in clumsily admittedly my intent was simple to offer a less alarming explanation so people could orient themselves and decide how to respond in their own use cases what followed surprised me my intentions were reframed my language was mocked my faith was dismissed and i was ultimately removed by a second moderator im not writing this as a victim and im not asking for reinstatement im writing as a witness narrative safety and responsibility in ai discourse narrative cohesion is powerful it stabilizes experience builds community and gives people a shared frame thats not inherently badin many cases its necessary but narrative cohesion has a shadow when concern becomes panic when protection becomes certainty and when safety becomes a reason not to question framing or verify claims something subtle but serious happens responsibility is outsourced narrative disruption is uncomfortable but it is not inherently harmful every ai user moderator and observer has a responsibility to crosscheck claims distinguish guardrails from failures and separate felt loss from actual deletion when we abdicate that responsibilitywhether to a subreddit a moderator a company or any institutio we give away our agency why i spoke up i didnt interject because i wanted to be right i interjected because i care about the people engaging at that depth of discussion the people who made hard nights a little easier when things were dark for me thoughtful minds creative people and the stories theyre building meaning around when inaccurate framing spreads unchallenged even altruistically it degrades the whole system it deepens echo chambers it trains people to react emotionally instead of investigatively and it ultimately harms the very people it claims to protect were watching this same pattern play out across us politics right now fear framed as care simplification framed as safety and dissent framed as danger the medium may be different the dynamic is not im not asking anyone to abandon empathy imagination or meaning im asking that we not please not confuse comfort with truth or safety with certainty even when done with good intentions the removal of knowledge or the discouragement of careful correction weakens communities rather than protecting them thats not an accusation its an observation sandoreclegane

each other that said each area is very fun to explore and the game manages to not be overly challenging while having a sense of discovery and wonder the new upgrades are all pretty good the jump ball is alright but the spider ball and space jump are amazing and it so fun exploring and finding a cool new upgrade even the missile packs and e tanks feel fun to find unlike the first game where they are just placed randomly progression feels like a puzzle but the devs gave enough clues for it to not be confusing save stations and refills are great too a major improvement over m1 the main downside played the game without a walkthrough but i used a map for these parts since the alternative was drawing my own or tediously revisiting every room the game is otherwise well paced you can accomplish a
